title: Verifying an Alien Dictionary
summary: Determine if the given list of words is sorted in lexicographical order based on the specified order of the alien language's alphabet.
statement: Determine if the given list of words is sorted in lexicographical order based on the specified order of the alien language's alphabet.
constraints: order is a permutation of the lowercase alphabet.
Return whether adjacent words are lexicographically nondecreasing under that alphabet.
hints: Only the first differing character decides a pair unless one word is a prefix.
Map characters to ranks and compare adjacent words.
At first difference reject decreasing rank; if none, reject a longer first word.
Adjacent nondecrease is sufficient for the entire list to be sorted.
editorial: Adjacent nondecrease is sufficient for the entire list to be sorted.

tests.explanation: The first differing letters h and l occur in the required order.
Under this alphabet, world must precede word, so the list is unsorted.
